abstract.p: Affect refers to the fundamental neural processes that generate and regulate emotions, moods, and feeling states. Affect and emotions are central to how we organize meaning, to our behaviour, to our health and well-being, and to our very survival. Despite this, and even though most of us are all intimately familiar with emotions in everyday life, there is much we do not know about how emotions work, and how they impact our lives. Affective Science is a broad interdisciplinary field that explores these and other related questions about affect and emotions.
